lines: 「Playing with mud isn't a hobby of mine!」
Without flinching in front of the countless mud monsters, Nao had changed into a Taimanin suit in a flash.
Nao was a user of the Light Escape Arts, which manipulated light, and was especially proficient at the “Condenser” Ninja Art, which concentrated it.
The kunai balls that were ejected from the leg holster of the Taimanin suit were weapons developed specially for Nao.
Laser beams were fired from the innumerable kunai balls, which flew freely through the air thanks to the light energy that Nao controlled.
The unavoidable light beams pierced through the mud monsters' bodies in the blink of an eye.
The mud golems had holes formed all over their bodies, and fell apart extremely easily.
「Amazing! Looks like Hebiko's not going to get her turn.」
Hebiko had also changed into her Taimanin suit, but there was no need to do anything to the mud golems, which collapsed one after another from Nao's lasers.
「Did you see that, Fuuma-kun? This is my true power―――Wha?」
The mud golems, which had seemed to be defeated, took back their original forms one after another, and started moving again.
Lasers were fired from the kunai balls again.
Once again this time, the mud golems crumbled easily, but immediately regenerated and started moving.
「Then, Hebiko will try. Octopus Leg Four Blade Style!!」
Hebiko's Four Blade Style slashed one of the mud golems apart, but
It promptly came back to life, as though that didn't matter to it in the slightest.
「There's nothing for it, huh? Fuuma-kun, these are the kind of times I called you here for.」
「Can't you do something about this with your knowledge?!」
「Just like always, Fuuma-chan will――― Eh? He's not here??」
「What did you say? Ah, Koro-chan's not here either!!」
Before they knew it, the figures of those two had disappeared.
The indestructible mud monsters were about to surround Nao and Hebiko.
